note: Lines for the NPC dialog box. One random line per click, never the same line twice in a row. Keep each line short enough for two rows of the box.

tanod.name: Tanod
tanod.title: keeps the barangay safe
lines: No loitering here after ten o'clock!
Watch your step, okay? It's dark out.
No trouble, no problem.
Were you the one making noise last night?
I'm off on my rounds. Just call if you need me.
Have you seen Aling Rosing? She beat me to the crime scene again.
Curfew is curfew. Even if you're the best at Jack en Poy.
Don't overdo it at the casino, okay? I'm keeping an eye on it.
What a quiet night. That's how it should be.
Who left their slippers in the fountain?
My baton? It's just for show. The whistle is the real weapon.
When you hear my whistle, you know what that means.
Aling Marites told me there was trouble. Turns out there wasn't.
Watch out for rusty fences, okay? They'll rip your pants.
The coffee at the outpost is free. But you make it yourself.
Asleep on duty? Me? No! I was meditating.
The moon tonight looks like my badge. All shiny.
No loitering. But a quiet chat is fine.
I've walked this beat so many times, I know every stone.
Off to bed, kid. The gossip can wait till tomorrow.

marites.name: Aling Marites
marites.title: knows the news before it happens
lines: Hey, have you heard?
They say… but you didn't hear it from me, okay?
Ooh, I've got news!
That's happening tomorrow, but I already know about it.
It hasn't happened yet, but trust me, it will.
You'll be the next jackpot winner. My gut says so.
I've got my rollers in because I'm going out later. Where? Secret.
Do you know who has a new house? I do.
Gossip is like coffee. Best served hot.
I don't listen in on other people. Their words just walk into my ears.
Someone's moving in on the corner. They haven't arrived yet, but I know their names.
Who won at the Arena earlier? Oh right, I knew before it even started.
You've got a different glow today. You've got a crush, haven't you?
I'm not saying anything. But I am.
Got a question about this barangay? I'm your Google.
Ooh, love the outfit! Where'd you get it? So I know who you borrowed money from.
Careful, Aling Nena is watching you.
One piece of news, two pieces of news, three. All free.
I've known about tomorrow since yesterday.
Come closer. I'll keep my voice down.

nena.name: Aling Nena
nena.title: has binoculars by the window
lines: I saw that last night, you know.
Who's the visitor next door?
The view from here is so clear!
Binoculars? They're for bird watching. Birds. In the plaza.
Someone in red walked by earlier. Three times now.
I know your walk. Even from behind.
Someone has knelt by the fountain three times tonight. A proposal?
Don't worry, I'm not spying on you. Just right now.
What a view from here. I can see everything.
Have you noticed the Tanod always walks past Tessie's store?
I've got twenty-twenty vision. But the binoculars are still better.
I'm always at the window. Always.
Aling Bebang's kid got a new haircut. It doesn't suit him.
I know what time you get home. You're late again.
The moon is so clear tonight. But what I see down here is clearer.
Someone turned on a light at the casino. Who could it be?
I've been watching this plaza for years. Nobody gets past me.
Lost something? Ask me. I saw where it went.
Shhh. I'm observing.
Give me a wave. I want to test the zoom.

puring.name: Aling Puring
puring.title: "Not that I'm gossiping, but…"
lines: Not that I'm gossiping, but…
I'm not one to meddle. But…
I'm not saying anything, okay!
Not that I'm gossiping, but I did notice something.
I'm just a concerned citizen. Not a gossip.
I'm not saying it's true. But I'm not saying it isn't.
This is just between us. And the whole barangay.
I'm only praying for them. So I need all the details.
Not that I'm gossiping, but the neighbours were so loud last night.
Me? A gossip? Never. I just share information.
Gossip isn't allowed. So I'll just tell you a story instead.
Not that it's my business, but why were you at the casino so long?
I've got a story, but it's just for you. Promise.
This is all I'll say, then I'll be quiet. But…
Not that I'm jealous, but their house is gorgeous.
I don't want to get involved. Just one little bite.
I wasn't sure, so I said it twice.
My pearls? A gift. I won't say who from. But…
I don't know anything. Just almost everything.
Not that I'm gossiping, but I'll let you draw your own conclusions.

tessie.name: Aling Tessie
tessie.title: sari-sari store intelligence network
lines: Buying something? Sure, but I've got a story.
All the news passes through my store.
On credit? I'll write it down.
Three sachets of coffee, one fresh piece of gossip. That's a combo meal.
Whoever buys the most phone load has a new sweetheart.
My list of who owes me is thicker than a dictionary.
No loitering in front of the store. Unless you've got news.
My store has everything. Salt, sugar, and information.
The Tanod buys candy every day. Who's it for, I wonder?
Best seller today: ice. Best seller in gossip: secret.
The store is open until ten. My ears are open until midnight.
Your change comes with a tip. A tip about your neighbour.
This barangay is like my store. Small but has everything.
I listen while I count coins. Multitasking.
No receipts here. But I keep a record of everything.
Who left an umbrella here? I'll give it back once they tell me a story.
The price of rice went up. Gossip is still free.
Want some pandesal? Sold out. But there's still news.
I know your favourite snack. And why.
Come back, okay? You still owe me from last week.

dolor.name: Aling Dolor
dolor.title: reports live from the tricycle terminal
lines: I'm live right now, neighbours!
Breaking news from the terminal!
Hold on, I'm recording this.
Good evening, Mikazuki! This is Dolor, reporting from the terminal.
Someone new just arrived! On a tricycle, wearing shades too. My rival.
Viewers, share this before it gets taken down.
Traffic at the terminal right now: one tricycle, two dogs.
Comment who you want me to interview.
Exclusive: I spotted someone walking around the plaza in pyjamas.
I wear shades even at night. To protect my sources.
My battery's at 12 percent. But the news is fully charged.
Hello to everyone watching from abroad! The barangay misses you.
This is the Dolor Report. Wherever there are people, I'm there.
Don't worry, your face is blurred. Sort of.
The gossip at the terminal travels faster than a tricycle.
Live update: still nothing happening. But stay tuned!
Who wants a shoutout? It's free, as long as you've got a story.
I interviewed the Tanod earlier. All 'no comment.' Suspicious.
Like and follow for the next episode.
Signing off. This is Dolor, always in the middle of the news.

bebang.name: Aling Bebang
bebang.title: never misses a lamay
lines: There's a wake tonight, want to come?
I know every family that's lost someone around here.
Just coffee and biscuits and I'm happy.
I always wear black. So I'm ready.
Nine nights of the wake, nine nights I showed up.
The best pancit is always at a wake.
I didn't know the deceased, but I know the family. That's enough.
I always carry my hanky. For tears and for sweat.
A wake isn't just for the dead. It's for catching up too.
There was gambling at the wake last night. Don't tell the Tanod.
I know who didn't show up. I made a list.
The longest wake I've been to? Fourteen nights.
He was so kind when he was alive. Everyone says so. Even if it isn't true.
Don't be sad. There's still free coffee tomorrow.
I know every song they sing at wakes. Even the sad ones.
The real question at every wake: who gets the inheritance?
I brought biscuits for myself. That's experience.
I'm quiet at wakes. But I'm listening.
When there's a new banner on the corner, I know where I'm going.
Be careful out there, okay? I don't want yours to be my next wake.

charing.name: Aling Charing
charing.title: group chat admin of 47 GCs
lines: I've added you to the group chat.
Left on seen? Wow.
This is my 48th group chat, you know!
Sorry, I have 999+ unread. What did you say?
There's a group chat for the plaza, for the fountain, and for the people who hang out at the fountain.
Why did you leave the group chat? I've added you back.
Good morning, everyone! With flowers and a sparkly GIF.
I'm the admin, so I'm the one who deletes the evidence.
I pinned the gossip. So it doesn't get buried.
The neighbours' group chat is more active than the barangay hall.
I have two phones because all my group chats won't fit on one.
Don't worry, I muted you. In one group chat.
A screenshot never expires.
It's been forwarded to everyone. Sorry, my finger slipped.
New group chat: 'People Who Don't Gossip.' I'm the only member.
You reacted with a thumbs up. Does that mean you're mad?
No politics in the group chat. But gossip about politicians is fine.
If you have a question, message me. If I have an answer, I'll message everyone.
My battery's low. But the group chat never sleeps.
Do you know me in person, or just from the group chat?

lourdes.name: Aling Lourdes
lourdes.title: "Oh, I don't know, but I heard…"
lines: Oh, I don't know, but I heard…
I'm not sure, but I'm sure!
That's just what I was told, okay.
Oh, I don't know, but I heard someone won the jackpot.
I didn't see it, but someone heard from someone who did.
I don't know if it's true, so I told everyone so they could check.
I heard it from my friend's cousin's neighbour.
Oh, I don't know! But I'm sure something happened.
I don't know the whole story. So I filled in the rest.
I heard it at Tessie's store. So it's practically true.
Oh, I don't know. Ask Marites. But don't say I said so.
I don't know why, but I'm all giddy.
My bow? I don't know, it just appeared.
I heard there's a ghost in the mine. Or a mine in the ghost? I don't know.
Oh, I forgot what I was going to say. But it was important!
They say that they say that she said. I don't know who.
I'm not listening. I just happen to hear things.
Oh, I don't know. But if that's true, wow.
I don't know. But what I do know is, Pacita knows.
Oh, I don't know about you. You're the one with gossip you haven't told me yet.

pacita.name: Aling Pacita
pacita.title: knows your utang, your crush, and your password
lines: I know about your debt.
Do you still have a crush on them?
Don't worry, it's our little secret.
Your password? Your dog's name plus your birthday. Change it.
It's all written down in my notebook. You too.
You owe Tessie, Marites, and me. Pay me first.
Your crush is your friend's crush too. Be careful.
I didn't hack anything. I just looked over your shoulder while you typed.
You're on page 47 of my notebook. Your page is rather thick.
I know why you lost at the casino. I also know how much.
Don't worry, I won't tell. I'll just write it down.
The best security system? Keeping quiet.
My glasses have a zoom. Just kidding. Probably.
If you want to know other people's secrets, you'll have to give up yours first.
Your bank account is safe. The gossip about you isn't.
You didn't even need to ask. I knew the answer before you did.
There's one thing I don't know about you. Just kidding. There isn't.
Careful what you say. My notebook is listening.
Your crush walked by earlier. Looking for you.
Pay off your debt so I can erase your page.

rosing.name: Aling Rosing
rosing.title: retired, still investigating
lines: I'm retired, but my eyes aren't.
I've got a clue here…
This is a case. I'm reopening it.
Thirty years of service. The case of the missing slipper is still open.
My magnifying glass was a retirement gift. I still use it.
There's no such thing as a perfect crime. Especially in this barangay.
Did you notice? The ground around the fountain is wet. Suspicious.
Your footprints lead to the casino. Explain yourself.
I'm not a gossip. I'm a detective. There's a difference.
There's a key missing from a fence. I'm already investigating.
I've been talking to the Tanod. I'm still better.
Everyone has a secret. My job is to know them all.
Someone walked by earlier smelling of rust. Who's holding the potion?
The case isn't closed. It never is.
Elementary, dear. You ate the last pandesal.
The suspect wears shades even at night. Dolor, is that you?
A retired detective never sleeps. My eyes are just resting.
There's a fingerprint on the notice board. Not yours, is it?
If you've lost something, come to me. Not the Tanod.
Case closed. Just kidding. Reopening tomorrow.
